madness mckenzie demons 8.7\" skateboard.name: Madness McKenzie Demons 8.7" Skateboard Deck
madness mckenzie demons 8.7\" skateboard.description: Designed with specific, unique dimensions as preferred by Jedd McKenzie for his signature pro model, Madness introduces the 8.7" wide Demons skateboard deck with an extended 32.6" length and a distinct 14.88" wheelbase. Sporting silver foil detailing on the bottom ply for shiny flash, Jedd's name sits beneath a two-faced silhouette framing an edgy "Los Capichos" print from dark Spanish artist Francisco Goya - originally drawn in the late 1700s for a truly gothic inspiration.

montale boise vanille — eau de parfum en.description: An ordinary day turned extraordinary is just a spray away with the exotic fragrance of Montale Boise Vanille for women, from Parisian perfume designer Pierre Montale. Reminiscent of the Orient, this vanilla based scent is infused with perfectly blended notes of lemon, bergamot, geranium, lavender and cedar, offering a lingering treat to your senses as you drift through your day. Give those around you a sensory boost as well with this intricately balanced, straightforwardly sophisticated perfume.
